scope: Current tree of the public repository. Git history before this change still holds the original bytes.

replacements.binary-same-length: /Users/usr and /home/u inside compiled name sections, so byte offsets stay valid

digestPolicy: Only digests that equal the sha256 (hex or base64) or sha512 (base64) of a file or archive member whose bytes this sanitization changed were rebound. Signatures, sourceRevision git SHAs, shard-set, conversion-config and model identities were not touched.
Rebinding ran bottom-up to a fixpoint: scrubbed leaves, then containing archives, then every manifest, index, receipt or SHA256SUMS that names them, repeating until no digest changed.
Size fields next to a rebound digest were updated when they equalled the original byte count.
JSON evidence whose digests were rebound carries pathSanitized: true and a pointer to this manifest, so rebound digests are not mistaken for raw runtime outputs.
runtimeOutputDigests lists rebound digests whose field names a captured runtime output (GPU capture, log, observation). Those digests now cover the sanitized capture, not the bytes the runtime wrote.
privateOriginals: The exact original bytes are retained by the maintainers outside every repository, with per-file sha256. originalSha256 below identifies them.
